I'm cloning the product at naano.com — a B2B LinkedIn Creator Marketplace SaaS. Research the CREATORS side (and the AGENCIES side) of the product in depth using WebFetch and WebSearch (do NOT use browser automation tools — only WebFetch and WebSearch).

To load WebFetch/WebSearch, first call ToolSearch with query "select:WebFetch,WebSearch".

Fetch and study these URLs (and any obvious sub-pages you discover):
- https://www.naano.xyz/creators
- https://naano.com/creators
- https://naano.com/for-agencies OR https://www.naano.xyz/agencies
- https://naano.com/about
- https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.naano.xyz (to understand how real users describe it)
- Any creator FAQ / help / how-payouts-work pages

I need a precise functional spec of the CREATOR-side (and agency-side) experience. Report back in structured markdown covering:
1. The exact end-to-end flow a creator goes through: apply/sign up → get vetted → build profile → set price per post → get discovered/invited → accept campaign → draft & submit content → get approved → publish → get paid. List each screen/step.
2. Every feature on the creator dashboard (profile/rate card, incoming campaign invites, content submission, earnings/payouts, analytics).
3. How creators are vetted and what makes a profile (bio, niche/topics, audience demographics, sample posts, price, ratings).
4. How payouts work (fixed price per post, payment timing, platform fee/commission if mentioned).
5. The AGENCIES side: what agencies do on the platform and what features they get.
6. Any specific UI copy, section headings, and CTA text you can capture verbatim (useful for a faithful clone).

Be concrete and exhaustive. Your final message is the deliverable — return raw structured findings, not a conversational summary.

# Naano — Functional Spec: CREATOR-side & AGENCY-side

## 0. What Naano is (context for the clone)

Naano is a **B2B LinkedIn Creator Marketplace** (founded 2025, Paris). It is effectively a **three-sided marketplace**: Brands/Companies (demand) ↔ Creators (supply) ↔ Agencies (intermediaries who manage either brands or creators). Creators are vetted LinkedIn micro/nano-creators (roughly 1K–500K followers) in B2B niches. Brands book them to publish sponsored posts; every post carries a tracked link so brands see clicks/leads/pipeline; Naano handles briefing, contracts, and payouts.

**Positioning copy (verbatim):**
- Company mission: *"Make creator marketing your most effective revenue channel."*
- Core belief: *"growth works better when it's driven by people, not ads."*
- Homepage hero: *"Where B2B brands work with creators"* / subhead: *"The B2B LinkedIn Creator Marketplace. Find the creators your buyers already trust, launch campaigns in days, and track the clicks, leads and pipeline generated by every post."*
- Category term they coined: **"Creator-Led Growth."**

**IMPORTANT pricing-model note for the clone:** Naano **migrated from a pay-per-click model to a fixed price-per-post model around July 2026.** The current live site (`naano.com`) uses **fixed per-post pricing set by each creator** (from ~€20/post). Older/alternate assets (e.g. the `naano-rebuild.vercel.app` prototype) still describe a **pay-per-qualified-click** model ("A click only counts when it could buy", "$0 Billed for unqualified clicks"). Clone the **fixed per-post** model as primary; treat per-click as legacy. Click *tracking* still exists (for brand attribution) but is no longer the billing basis.

Note: `naano.xyz` 308-redirects to `naano.com`. `/for-agencies` returns 404; the live agency page is `/agencies`.

---

## 1. Creator end-to-end flow (each screen/step)

**Entry / marketing page** — `/creators`
- Hero: **"Get paid to post on LinkedIn"**
- Subhead: **"Choose deals from B2B brands you know, post in your own voice, and get paid within 24h."**
- Trust bar: **"Free to join · No exclusivity · Paid within 24h"**
- Primary CTA: **"Start earning"**; secondary: **"See how it works"**

**Step 1 — Apply / Sign up**
- CTA **"Start earning"** / **"Apply now"**
- Copy: **"Takes 2 minutes. No commitment."**, **"Free to join"**
- Application-based (creator submits, gets vetted/approved before being listed).

**Step 2 — Get vetted** (gate before profile goes live)
- Naano reviews audience fit (see §3). Screening emphasizes ICP fit over follower count; reported new-creator bar in some regions: **15K+ followers, UK/US/Canada, business owners or tech creators** — but the broader roster spans ~1K–500K followers across 100 countries, so the hard bar is not uniformly enforced.

**Step 3 — Build profile / media kit**
- Feature: **"Launch a professional media kit in minutes"**
- Auto-pulls LinkedIn stats: followers, est. median reach, engagement rate, avg reactions/comments, recent posts, audience breakdowns, topics/verticals, location, bio (see §3 for the exact field list).

**Step 4 — Set rate / price per post**
- Creator sets their **own fixed price per post** (example shown: €800/post; another profile: €313/post).
- Supports **bundles** (e.g. 3 posts, 5 posts at a discount).
- Rate is **shown before booking** ("shown before booking").

**Step 5 — Get discovered / invited**
- Feature: **"Centralized opportunities"** — *"Discover brand deals that match your audience"*
- Two pathways: (a) accept **pre-vetted Naano deals**, or (b) **"bring your own deals & get paid faster"** (with a **"Naano bonus + €300"** incentive shown for BYO deals).
- Invite arrives as a **collaboration request** notification. Example: **"Attio sent a collaboration request."**

**Step 6 — Review deal & Accept/Decline**
- Deal card shows: deal type (e.g. "Sponsored post"), fixed price (e.g. €1,000), deliverables + deadline (e.g. **"1 post + 1 repost by Aug 12"**).
- Buttons: **"Accept"** / **"Decline"**.

**Step 7 — Draft & submit content**
- Each brief includes an **angle, a hook, and a CTA**, plus **full access to the product** being promoted.
- Creator writes **"the post in your own words, your own style"** / **"post in your own voice"** and **"keep control of your content."**
- Feature: **"Easy delivery"** — *"Manage deals and deliver content with ease."*

**Step 8 — Get approved**
- Brand reviews the draft before it goes live (*"you review before anything goes live"*). Status states tracked in the platform: **draft → scheduled → live**.

**Step 9 — Publish**
- Post goes live from the **creator's own personal LinkedIn account** (*"where LinkedIn concentrates organic reach"*), embedding a **tracked link**.

**Step 10 — Get paid**
- Feature: **"Payments built-in"** — *"Get paid on time with secure, transparent payouts."*
- Paid via **SEPA / Stripe**, **within 24h** (marketed as **"Instant · SEPA"**), status: **"Payment received Today."**
- **"No invoice, no chasing."** Creators **"keep 100% of what you earn."**

**Step 11 — Track performance (ongoing)**
- Feature: **"Track performance"** — *"See views, clicks and engagement in real time."*
- Example metrics surfaced: 42.8K impressions / 312 clicks / 18 leads; 100K impressions / 1,600 clicks / 320 leads.

---

## 2. Creator dashboard — every feature

1. **Profile / Media Kit** — public, shareable media kit (see §3 fields).
2. **Rate card** — fixed per-post price + bundle tiers (3-post, 5-post), editable by creator.
3. **Availability badge** — **"Available to book."**
4. **Incoming campaign invites / Opportunities** ("Centralized opportunities") — inbound collaboration requests + a feed of matched brand deals; each with type, price, deliverables, deadline, Accept/Decline.
5. **Bring-your-own deals** — creator imports their own brand deals to settle through Naano (with bonus incentive).
6. **Content submission / delivery** ("Easy delivery") — draft submission, brief with angle/hook/CTA + product access, revisions, scheduling, status (draft/scheduled/live).
7. **Earnings / Payouts** ("Payments built-in") — payout history, SEPA/Stripe transfers, "paid within 24h", no invoicing, 100% retained.
8. **Analytics** ("Track performance") — real-time views, clicks (tracked-link), engagement, leads per post.

---

## 3. Vetting & profile composition

**Vetting basis (audience fit over follower count):**
- Naano surfaces/ranks creators **"by audience fit, not follower count"** — *"a creator with 4,000 on-ICP followers beats one with 80,000 mixed followers."*
- Manual quality check: reading the **comments** to confirm the **right job titles** are actually engaging.
- Reported hard filters for some new applicants: min ~15K followers, UK/US/Canada, business owner or tech creator (not uniformly applied across the whole roster).

**What a creator profile contains (from live profile page):**
- **Name** + **headline/title** (e.g. "Turning LinkedIn into Revenue | Co-founder @Naano")
- **Avatar**, **"Available to book"** status badge
- **Followers** (e.g. 13K), **Est. median reach** (e.g. 11.8K), **Engagement rate** (e.g. 1.1%)
- **Location** (e.g. FR), **"Stats updated 13 d ago"** freshness stamp
- **Average metrics**: avg reactions (e.g. 82), avg comments (e.g. 57)
- **Audience breakdown — By Seniority** (Founder/C-level, VP/Head/Director, Manager/Lead, Senior IC — as %)
- **Audience breakdown — By Function** (Founders, Marketing, Engineering/Data, Sales/BD, Finance/VC, Product — as %)
- **Recent Posts** — ~4 recent LinkedIn posts with engagement + images
- **About** — bio
- **Topics / Verticals** — tags (e.g. AI, Marketing, Growth/GTM)
- **Pricing** — per-post rate + bundles; CTA **"Book a post→"**
- Brand verticals present on platform: B2B SaaS, Fintech, DevTools, E-commerce
- (No explicit star-rating widget observed; social proof is via engagement metrics + testimonials rather than a per-creator star rating.)

---

## 4. How payouts work

- **Model:** Fixed **price per post**, set by the creator, visible to brands before booking. Bundles (3/5 posts) at a discount. (Legacy: per-qualified-click — deprecated.)
- **Who pays:** Naano collects from the brand and pays the creator directly ("Naano handles the payment"); on Managed/agency, "Naano handles all payouts on your behalf."
- **Method:** **SEPA** bank transfer / **Stripe**.
- **Timing:** **within 24h** of the post going live, marketed as **"Instant."** ("get paid the moment the post went live.")
- **Admin:** **No invoice required** ("No invoice, no chasing").
- **Commission/fee:** Publicly, **"keep 100% of what you earn"** — **no creator-side commission is disclosed.** No explicit platform take-rate is published anywhere on the site. Platform revenue on the brand side comes from the **Managed** retainer (€700/mo) and Managed-custom quotes, not a stated per-transaction cut. (For a faithful clone, model the creator payout as 100% of their set price; if you want revenue, add a brand-side markup or subscription rather than a creator commission, to match their public promise.)
- **Terms:** **"No exclusivity"**, **"Quit anytime, keep your earnings."**
- **Median creator rates (their published Jun–Aug 2026 data):** <5K followers €84/post; 5–10K €180/post; 10–25K €312/post. Marketed averages: ~€500 avg/deal, examples €800–€2,000+, up to €5,000.

Agency page (`/agencies`) hero: **"Choose the workspace that matches your agency."** / subhead: **"Naano separates brand operations from creator management. Choose your setup and create the right workspace for your agency."**

- CTA: **"Create a brand agency workspace"** (note: *"You will create the agency manager account first."*)

  - **"Track collaborations and earnings"**

- CTA: **"Create a creator agency workspace"**

**Sales assist section:** heading **"Not sure which workspace fits your agency?"** → offer: *"Book a 30-minute agency call. We will look at how you manage clients or creators and point you to the right setup."* CTA **"Book a call"** ("30 minutes with the Naano team. No commitment.").

**Agency features (synthesized):** multi-client / multi-brand portfolio; per-client workspaces with isolated budgets, campaigns, and reporting; CSV roster import for talent agencies; rate & profile management on behalf of creators; agency-manager (owner) account model with sub-workspaces; campaign + collaboration + earnings tracking.
